# Executive Translation

> Executive Translation (executivetranslation.com) is a career repositioning and promotion coaching practice founded by Kendra Weinisch. It is not a language translation service. Kendra helps senior experts (engineers, data scientists, analysts, scientists, and finance, legal and product specialists) and international leaders get promoted into leadership, inside their company or by moving to a bigger role. A former journalist, she has delivered 1,100+ hours of 1:1 coaching, with 50+ successful client outcomes and 25+ five-star reviews.

## Offers
- [Clarity Sprint](https://executivetranslation.com/clarity-sprint): two weeks, 1:1, $1,000. Intake review, 90-minute Translation Session, written Translation Brief with positioning, rewritten proof stories and a 30-day plan, plus a 30-minute follow-up. Often covered by employer learning budgets.
- [Clarity Sprint for International Leaders](https://executivetranslation.com/clarity-sprint-global): the same two-week Sprint for CTOs, CFOs, directors and senior engineers who lead, present and interview in English, covering executive pitching, boardroom communication, negotiation and job interviews. $1,000.
- [Executive Positioning](https://executivetranslation.com/executive-positioning): private 1:1 program for promotions and executive roles.

## Who it is for
- Senior individual contributors, Staff/Principal engineers, managers and new directors in specialist functions earning roughly $140k–$300k who are "ready next cycle" but not being promoted.
- International leaders (CTOs, CFOs, directors, senior engineers) who lead, present and interview in English as a second or third language at global or US companies.
